entries.title_ar: منهاج السنة النبوية في نقض كلام الشيعة والقدرية (Ibn Taymiyyah)
entries.set_scope: Catalogued as v.1-2 (Columbia call no. BP166 .I438 1904). Label as 'v.1-2 as catalogued', not a full-work claim. Pagination restarts later in the file, consistent with two volumes; exact volume boundary and completeness against the printed work not verified.
entries.notes: Scan of the physical books incl. covers and library marks. No title page seen in first 14 pages; edition identity rests on NYU catalogue.

entries.title_ar: صحيح مسلم، الجزء الأول (Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj)
entries.set_scope: Volume 1 of the catalogued set. Title page seen at pdf p.5: صحيح مسلم ... الجزء الأول ... عيسى البابي الحلبي وشركاه.
entries.notes: Legible page images. 1931 print: weaker age support than 1904; basis is NYU's statement.

entries.title_ar: صحيح مسلم، الجزء الثاني (Muslim ibn al-Hajjaj)
entries.edition: Misr, 'Isa al-Babi al-Halabi, 1349H [1931] (date read from its own ACO page)
entries.set_scope: Volume 2; file ends with a subject index (printed pp. ~573-576). Not checked against other editions' volume counts.
entries.notes: Legible page images. ACO page sizes: hi 352.05 MB, lo 78.79 MB (lo matches downloaded bytes).

entries.title_ar: صحيح البخاري (الجزء الأول والثاني) وبهامشه حاشية السندي وتقريرات من شرحي القسطلاني وشيخ الإسلام
entries.author: Muhammad ibn Isma'il al-Bukhari (d. 256H); marginal commentary: al-Sindi (d. 1138H) with notes from al-Qastallani and Zakariyya al-Ansari
entries.edition: Date not printed on the title page I read; Columbia call no. BP135.A3 B84 1894; publisher field blank in ACO
entries.set_scope: Catalogued as V. 1-2 only. Title page at pdf p.7 reads 'الجزء الأول'. Very probably a partial set of Bukhari; a related 1932 edition on ACO is 4+ volumes. Label as 'vols. 1-2 as catalogued', not the full Sahih.
entries.notes: Real printed title page seen; marginal commentary present, so it is Bukhari with Sindi's hashiya, not a bare text. Cataloguing date 1894 comes from the call number only; I did not verify it from the book.
